frequency_question: What proportion of RBI draft regulatory frameworks for digital lending/NBFCs reach final implementation within 12 months of proposal?
membership_rule: Includes formal draft guidelines, discussion papers, or proposed frameworks specifically targeting digital lending, microfinance, or NBFC pricing/conduct issued by the RBI since 2015. Excludes routine monetary policy announcements and generic circulars without structural regulatory intent.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional

validity_reason: RBI regulatory process stability remains consistent across multi-year cycles.
